name: Kurata Chisato
source:
Natsumi's roommate and classmate of Natsumi & Shinichiro. She always has a friendly smile.

She and Natsumi have been best friends for a long time and also work together at Sunnyside. She seems serious but has a good sense of humor, and even Natsumi's flashy part-time clothes were designed by her.

Since she is always with Natsumi, she knows many things that even Natsumi herself is unaware of.

[From [url=https://www.pulltop.com/gp07/02_chara05-01.html]official site[/url]]
